description: Expose immutable DirectComposition COM interfaces with Win7 target macros. Upstream loads dcomp.dll and DCompositionCreateDevice at runtime; this patch changes declarations only.

replacements.after:
// XLWebEngineUI: declarations only; runtime feature probing remains upstream.
#pragma push_macro("NTDDI_VERSION")
#pragma push_macro("_WIN32_WINNT")
#pragma push_macro("WINVER")
#undef NTDDI_VERSION
#undef _WIN32_WINNT
#undef WINVER
#define NTDDI_VERSION 0x06030000
#define _WIN32_WINNT 0x0603
#define WINVER 0x0603
#include <dcomp.h>
#pragma pop_macro("WINVER")
#pragma pop_macro("_WIN32_WINNT")
#pragma pop_macro("NTDDI_VERSION")
